cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

mechanism: A praises its former pupil independence through increasingly tender gifts whose language turns an ordinary tea visit into a possible final departure.
confusable: Not a straightforward dismissal or generic kindness: warmth grows alongside farewell implications, and B notices that unsettling combination.
comparison: Teacup keepsake versus food for a short journey treated as lasting separation.
